(3)  Every appointment made under this section shall be
subject to the provisions of section 18.
(4) The Deputy Governors of the Central Bank shall be
employees of the Central Bank and shall be subject to such
age of retirement, as may be determined by the Governing
Board in line with the criteria applicable in the public sector.
(5)      The  appointment  of  the  Deputy  Governors  of  the
Central  Bank  and  the  designation  of  the  Senior  Deputy
Governor of the Central Bank shall be made in a transparent
manner.
(6) The appointments referred to in subsection (1) shall
be finalized not less than a period of thirty days prior to the
expiration of the term of office of the previously appointed
member.
(7)  In  the  event  of  the  President  failing  to  make  an
appointment referred to in subsection (1) within a period of
thirty days from the date of concurrence of the Constitutional
Council,  the  person  recommended  by  the  Minister  and
concurred  by  the  Constitutional  Council  under  subsection
(1), shall be deemed to have been appointed as the Governor
of the Central Bank, members of the Governing Board and
the experts of the Monetary Policy Board, with effect from
the date of expiry of such period.

17.
(1) The term of office of an appointed member shall
be  a  period  of  six  years  commencing  on  the  date  of  his
appointment.
(2) Where any appointed member vacates office before
the expiration of his term of office, another person shall be
appointed in terms of section 16 in his place within a period
of sixty days to hold office during the unexpired period of
the term of office of the appointed member so vacating the
office.
